title: Pilori
description: PILORI was formed in Rouen (France), and played its first gig in March 2016 - since then, their abrasive, dark, direct, and impactful sound, filled with profound darkness and violent flashes of light, has constantly evolved through diverse influences.
address: The Tooth & Claw, 50 Baron Taylor's St, Inverness, IV1 1QG
